deploy.command: vercel deploy --prod --scope the-aie --yes   # the deploy verb is required: bare `vercel --prod` printed a suggestion block and deployed nothing on CLI 59.23.1; run from the merged main checkout linked to conference-os-ata; delete the .env.local that `vercel link` wrote; record the SHA in the sync PR
deploy.notes: Project docs say Production Branch = release, but the repo has no release branch, so merging to main yields a Preview only. The last two production deployments (2026-10-18, 2026-10-21) were source=cli by mrhinkle-theaie with no git metadata.

syncFrom.method: worktree from origin/main, branch sync/<topic>-<core-pr>, git cherry-pick -x <core merge sha>, then git commit --amend --no-edit --author="Mark Hinkle <mrhinkle@peripety.com>" -s (DCO requires author email == Signed-off-by email)
syncFrom.title: chore(core): sync ConferenceOS #NNNN (<summary>)

reviewEvidence.notes: Owner attestation at the exact head was accepted on #46 (2026-10-15); same evaluator as core, so expect the same-actor rule. Get a cross-vendor read of the cherry-pick diff first.

targets.schema: Production migrations via core Actions → production-migrate (workflow_dispatch: install=conference-os-ata, payload_sha, optional rehearsal_target) BEFORE the CLI code deploy; Mark's call.
targets.postDeployConfig: Install MCP at /api/mcp on the public host (cos_admin key) or /organizer admin. Example: update_site_announcement after the deploy is READY.
targets.verify: get_deployment(withGitRepoInfo) or vercel inspect <url> --scope the-aie: READY, target production, alias includes events.allthingsai.org; then curl the affected route.
